title: Updates
hint: Git Desktop checks GitHub Releases for new versions. Nothing is downloaded without your say-so.
autoCheckHint: Shows a prompt when a newer version is out.
includePrereleaseHint: Offer beta versions too. They may be less stable.
upToDate: You are on the latest version
reinstallHint: Download this version again and run its installer.

modal.title: Update available
modal.subtitle: Version {{version}} is out — you have {{current}}.
modal.readyBodyWin: Git Desktop will close and the installer will start.
modal.readyBodyMac: Git Desktop will close and the disk image will open. Drag Git Desktop into Applications to replace the old version.
modal.readyBodyLinux: The file will be shown in its folder. Install the .deb with your package manager, or replace your AppImage with it.

errors.rateLimited: GitHub is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.noAsset: This release has no download for your system.
errors.busy: A download is already in progress.
errors.repoBusy: Wait for the current Git operation to finish.
errors.devBuild: Updates cannot be installed from a development build.
